title: Reject unsafe Git revision values
summary: Validate artifact base and stage revisions as full SHA-1 object IDs before invoking Git diff.
rationale: The viewer treats repository artifacts as input. Revision values must be constrained before they cross the process boundary so they cannot become Git command options.

decisions.summary: Recheck revision syntax in the diff service immediately before process execution.
decisions.rationale: The viewer may receive invalid artifacts before the validation endpoint completes, so the sensitive operation must enforce its own input boundary.

risks.summary: A malformed revision beginning with a dash could be interpreted as a git diff option and alter command behavior or write output.
risks.mitigation: Require the standard's exact lowercase 40-character SHA-1 format before invoking Git.

validation.summary: Rejects option-shaped artifact revisions before Git execution while preserving valid stage diff behavior.
The finalized hardening stage and all previous stage diffs remain processable.
